checks.behavior_smoke: One complete synthetic input produced nine designs in an independent run. Its targeted repairs passed independent recheck. One blank-input run and three conflict-input runs stopped for human clarification. Applicable mechanical gates and both human-report routes passed.

behavior_evidence_scope.complete_input: Independent c7 run produced all nine files; review found ambiguous native table identity, two Markdown delimiter rows, and a working UC-map defect. Root repaired these in c9. The other eight design files are byte-identical; an independent targeted recheck closed all three findings. This is not a fresh independent c9 run from scratch.
behavior_evidence_scope.blank_and_conflict: One blank and three conflict runs used candidate 4. Their input, analysis and clarification contracts remain unchanged. route-evidence-reuse-c7.json records exact comparisons; candidate 9 separately verifies that unresolved questions stop before the added format check.
behavior_evidence_scope.format: Six directed format cases passed on c8. The c9 renderer is byte-identical, and one additional c9 case confirms unresolved-question precedence.
behavior_evidence_scope.human_report: The complete/review-ready and clarification-required reports independently passed on c7. Subsequent changes do not alter that report contract. Complete-with-no-user-action is N/A: the design route always ends pending chief architect review.
behavior_evidence_scope.mechanical: Applicable persistent-skill, host-format, anchor, twelve directed-mutant, trigger and competition checks passed. M6 is SKIP because this is not a network skill.

known_evidence_limitations: Only one explicit synthetic complete brief was used and reused during iteration. No real customer or held-out complete project validates cross-project stability.
The final evidence combines an independent full run with root-authored targeted repairs and an independent recheck; it is not a new independent from-scratch success.

The original conflict3 report has source anchors offset by two lines; conflict2 does not separately anchor the interview's direct-start directive. Both stop routes were correct. Original defects and reviewer-side corrections remain in platform-provenance-notes.json.

The complete-run log contains summarized command output and does not include a per-reference read receipt. Retained artifacts alone cannot prove every bundled reference was read. The parent separately captured exact mechanical-audit stdout.
Live team binding, resource IDs, identity mapping, effective native permissions and revocation, installed-host operation, implementation and publication remain unverified.
